stepTitle: Finding re.findall Output from a Capturing Group
stepBody: Mir’s next assignment is to isolate keywords from some of the park’s online reviews. He decides the best way to do this is to use a RegEx pattern, and writes the following lines of code to extract data from a string called $$review_1$$. What will be the output of Mir’s code? Recall that re.findall returns a list of matches. Format your answer like: ['string_1', $$'string_{2'}$$, 'string_3']##figure2.gif##
